name: Pointer

sources.title: Homepage — engineering-leadership newsletter, 60,574 subscribers, 726 issues, twice-weekly 5-min briefings
Sponsorship page — enquiry form + email contact; audience = experienced engineering managers at top-tier tech companies

requirements: This is a curated newsletter, not a directory — there is no product submission form
Only verified submission surface is paid sponsorship (form or email on /sponsorship)

Organic inclusion is editorial: the editor hand-picks articles on engineering management, industry news, trends, and guides — a product launch alone is not the format; a strong engineering-leadership article is
preparation: For sponsorship: name, email, and the message/creative to run in an issue
For editorial coverage: a genuinely strong blog post on engineering management/leadership — the newsletter summarizes articles, so the article (not the product) is the pitch unit
Contact: the sponsorship page's form or the listed email address
workflow: Paid: open https://pointer.io/sponsorship, complete the enquiry form or email the address listed

Editorial: publish a high-quality engineering-management article and make it discoverable — the editor curates from public writing; you may email the contact address to flag it, but no pitch form exists
Sponsorship delivers an 'integrated message' slot in an issue
watchFor: No launch listing exists — do not treat as a directory
Audience is senior engineering leadership at companies like Google, Stripe, AWS — consumer/growth pitches are a mismatch
Anti-spam protection on forms (Cloudflare email obfuscation) — use the rendered page, not scraped text
Sponsorship pricing is not published — enquire
countsAsLive: Your sponsored message or article appears in a sent Pointer issue (newsletter archive/email)
unknowns: Whether the editor accepts pitched articles proactively
